findings.summary: _plan_review_this_request_awaits still duplicates _standing_plan_review's live plan-review scan; the reuse finding remains unrepaired despite the manifest's acted claim.
findings.text: non-blocking: _plan_review_this_request_awaits still re-implements the live plan-review scan the repository already owns at reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:2060 (_standing_plan_review): it loops the live pointers matching node.id against PLAN_REVIEW_NODE_PREFIX + plan, adding only a session filter and an injected pointer list. The manifest records 'acted [dimension-reuse]: 5bc4b6be99', but that commit consolidated the queued-kind decision between the two producers and removed the re-spelled refusal constant; it did not extend the owner with a session-filtered, pointer-list-accepting variant, so the duplication the earlier review named is unchanged.

findings.summary: The one-builder invariant is guarded only by an uncommitted scratch script; no test fails if a producer regains its own queued-kind branch.
findings.text: non-blocking: the invariant this commit introduces — that a queued row's kind is decided in one builder and nowhere else — has no committed test. Its only control is a scratch script at /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261108T183346522188-.../reuse-check.py, recorded in logs/reuse-check-{head,reverted}.log, which will not survive the run. A producer that regains its own queued-kind branch leaves the five behavioural cases green, so the consolidation can decay silently; a structural test over the two producers belongs in tests/test_a_request_waiting_on_a_queued_plan_review_is_a_wait.py.
